title: Graph authority manifest
root_cause: Multiple legitimate graph projections exist without an explicit purpose, authority, source revision, builder, consumer, invalidation, and rebuild manifest.
source_requirement: Describe each major graph without merging different graph semantics.
implementation_steps: Declare purpose and authority per graph.
Bind source revisions, builder, consumers, invalidation, and gate.
Reject duplicate authority or unowned graph.
negative_cases: One giant graph replaces distinct semantics.
affected_tests: Generated graph and architecture invariant tests.
evidence_required: Complete graph inventory and owner-resolution receipt.
rollback: Remove manifest consumers while preserving existing independent graph files.
acceptance_criteria: Every major graph is accounted for with one authority contract.
